purpose: Test whether the promoted three-state hot/cold coolant topology has a jointly feasible development region before any M1 optimizer or blind prediction is permitted.

amendments.timing: after Stage A completion but before any Stage B conclusion
amendments.change: replace Stage B f_open midpoint 0.925 with the frozen Stage A reference value 0.95
amendments.reason: Stage B must contain the Stage A reference control point to remain a nested robustness envelope. The omission was a manifest design inconsistency, not a data-driven range change.

classification.robust_joint_survivor: same global parameter configuration passes cold start and passes hot start under all nine preregistered hidden-state initialization combinations
classification.conditional_joint_survivor: same global parameter configuration passes cold start and passes hot start under at least one but not all nine preregistered hidden-state initialization combinations
classification.non_survivor: fails cold start or fails hot start under every preregistered hidden-state initialization combination

stage_B_control_robustness_if_needed.opening_rule: Open only if Stage A has zero robust survivors. Apply only to Stage A conditional survivors, or if none exist, to the full Stage A structural grid for falsification.
stage_B_control_robustness_if_needed.interpretation_rule: A Stage B-only survivor is control-boundary-dependent evidence and does not by itself authorize a blind prediction.

gate_interpretation.one_or_more_stage_A_robust_survivors: M1 is structurally viable on consumed development evidence; freeze a separate calibration/holdout protocol before any blind rung.
gate_interpretation.stage_A_conditional_only: M1 adequacy is hidden-state-initialization-sensitive; do not open blind evidence until hidden-state treatment is independently constrained.
gate_interpretation.zero_stage_A_survivors: Execute Stage B exactly as preregistered before considering M1 rejection.
gate_interpretation.zero_stage_B_conditional_survivors: M1 is rejected by the governed development envelope and M2 model-form planning may begin.
gate_interpretation.stage_B_only_survivors: M1 remains control-boundary-dependent and blind prediction remains blocked pending stronger physical boundary evidence.
